messages:
maria: Heads up — EUC1 fleet provisioning is failing after last night's BMC firmware push. GPUs in several racks are stuck in 'maintenance', OOB heartbeats are intermittent, and I'm seeing secureboot toggles on ~120 nodes.
ash: Seeing same here. Scheduler queues spiking, pods can't bind to nodes in eu-central1, started evicting low-priority jobs.
devops-jen: Can we pause the rollout? Which image was pushed?
maria: Pausing now. Image is `bmc-fw-2026-03-18-v3`. Reverting the canary didn't fully restore OOB heartbeats — suspect a regsync issue where `secure_boot` bit flipped on certain vendor BMCs after NVRAM write.
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: 120 nodes in eu-central1 reported OOB_UNRESPONSIVE -> runbook: /runbooks/bmc-oob-rollback :rotating_light:
sre-liu: Debug snippet from affected node (euc1-r12-n08):
```
# ipmitool lan print
No response from RAKP request
BMC: vendor-A v3.0.12
Config: secure_boot=1 (expected 0)
```
harry: If we don't stabilize, scheduler fallback + cross-region hotmoves will spike costs. Rough projection: 3h degraded scheduling ~= $12k extra this week. tagging @cost-ops
cost-ops: Confirmed. Cross-region failover + autoscaler churn will double GPU spend if unresolved in 24h.
ash: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout (jen done) 2) drain affected racks and hot-move critical workloads to eu-west-2 3) route new allocations to dedicated pools in us-west while we triage.
devops-jen: Trying a soft management-plane revert: `fleetctl set-bmc-flag --nodes=@euc1-faulty --secureboot=0` — but IPMI auth fails on ~40% of the list, returning "RAKP authentication error".
maria: Can infra trigger power-cycle on the worst offenders? Last time a powercycle + NVRAM clear cleared the sticky secureboot bit on vendor-A units.
harry: Ops heads are limited in region. Suggest escalate to vendor for emergency signed-image revert. Meanwhile, staging extra dedicated capacity in us-west to keep SLAs.
sre-liu: I'll run manual reflash on a 5-node canary (rack euc1-r12) and verify OOB heartbeat for 30m. If stable, we do a 1hr rolling revert for remaining affected racks.
devops-jen: :thumbsup: starting manual reflash on euc1-r12 now. ETA ~45m. I'll document exact steps.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20260321-042 - Severity: High - assigned: devops-jen, maria, sre-liu
cost-ops: Also watch autoscaler churn metrics — we're already at cost-alert threshold. Recommend temporary cap on non-critical scale-ups.
maria: Reminder: do NOT run fleet-wide `bios-reset` — that toggles boot-order and caused two nodes into reboot-loop in last deploy. Use the NVRAM-wipe script from the runbook instead.
harry: Putting a hard hold on further BMC updates until postmortem. We need a reconciler test for secureboot bit parity across firmware upgrades.
devops-jen: Agreed — adding an ipmi RAKP auth smoke test for fw v3 into the preflight suite.
maria: I'll draft RCA skeleton after we stabilize. For now: rollback canary -> manual reflash -> cross-region lift-if-needed. Thanks everyone for the quick response.
